sections.Profile:
"Happy Papeete" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1963. Designed for two players, it features four flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and two rollunder lanes.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Travel, Women, Good Times, Pirates, Original Theme
